titulo: The movie on a channel that wasn't real

frases.texto: Your TV remote used to play the movie on a channel that wasn't real.
The tape never went into the TV.
The TV only had a hole for the antenna.
So the VCR turned the movie into its own tiny station.
frases.dicho: So the V C R turned the movie into its own tiny station.

frases.texto: You set that station to channel three, or to channel four.
Whichever one your city wasn't already using.
One button on the remote chose the antenna, or that fake station.
The movie was never a channel. The button just let the little station through.
Today the picture rides its own cable.
The source button just picks which one.
The app is in the link in bio.
Send it to that friend who still hunts for channel three.
